# netactuate_cloud_location (Data Source)

Reads a Cloud Location.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_location" "example" {
  location_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location_id` (Number) Cloud location ID to read.

### Read-Only

- `city` (String) Cloud location city.
- `country` (String) Cloud location country.
- `flag` (String) Cloud location flag value.
- `iata_code` (String) Cloud location IATA code.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `latitude` (String) Cloud location latitude, or an empty string when the API returns null.
- `location` (String) Cloud location code.
- `longitude` (String) Cloud location longitude, or an empty string when the API returns null.
- `name` (String) Cloud location name.
